1. Mr. Aditya Singh learned counsel

2023 and Mr. Harshit Sanwal, learned 
counsel for the petitioner in WPMS 
Nos. 1182 of 2024 and 1189 of 2024.
2. Mr. M.S. Bisht, learned Brief 
Holder for the State-Respondent Nos.1 
to 4.
3. Mr. Bhavya Pratap Singh, learned 
counsel for the respondent No.5.
4. Mr. Tyagi, learned Senior 
counsel, assisted by Mr. Prabhakar 
Narayan, learned counsel for

in which WPMS No.1275 of 2023 was

2023 by Coordinate Bench having 
roaster, which are not nominated to 
this Bench.

placed again before the Hon’ble Chief 
Justice for nomination.
